title: Pendulum lab
summary: Swing a real (non-linear) pendulum: change length, gravity, amplitude, mass and damping, and watch the period, energy and θ–t graph live.

title: Projectile lab
summary: Launch a ball at any speed, angle and height — with or without air resistance — and hit targets while reading range, height and time of flight.

title: Circuit lab
summary: Wire three bulbs in series, parallel or a mix, set the battery and resistances, and see Ohm’s law, current flow and power live.

title: Lens & optics lab
summary: Move an object in front of a convex or concave lens and watch the three principal rays form real or virtual images, with the lens formula and magnification live.

title: pH & titration lab
summary: Titrate strong or weak acid with NaOH drop by drop, watch real indicator colours and a live titration curve, find the equivalence point and pKa.

title: Cell explorer
summary: Tap every part of an animal cell, a plant cell and a bacterium to learn what each organelle does — then find them in a guided hunt.

title: Human body explorer
summary: Explore the organs of six body systems, then exercise the body and watch heart rate, cardiac output and breathing respond.

title: Virtual microscope
summary: Use a realistic light microscope: choose slides, switch objectives, focus with coarse and fine knobs, adjust light and oil, and measure real cell sizes.

title: Graph plotter
summary: Type up to three functions, slide parameters a, b, c, pan and zoom, trace values and roots — and match target curves to master transformations.

title: Triangle geometry lab
summary: Drag the corners of a triangle and watch sides, angles, area, Pythagoras’ squares, circumcircle, incircle, medians and altitudes update live.

title: Probability lab
summary: Flip coins, roll dice and spin spinners thousands of times; compare experimental and theoretical probability and watch the law of large numbers.

title: Fraction pizza
summary: Cut two pizzas into equal slices, tap slices to make fractions, and discover equivalent fractions, comparing and adding — with decimals and percentages.

title: Turtle Code
summary: Write tiny Logo-style programs (FD, RT, REPEAT) to steer a turtle and draw shapes — learn sequences, loops, debugging and the 360° turning rule.

title: Budget Simulator
summary: Plan a monthly budget in rupees, test it against the 50/30/20 rule, then live through a year of surprise bills and a credit-card debt to see why emergency funds matter.

title: Compound Interest Lab
summary: See money grow: compare compound and simple interest, compounding frequency, SIPs, the Rule of 72 and the bite of inflation on a live growth chart.

title: Water Cycle
summary: Heat the ocean, push clouds with the wind and make it rain or snow on a mountain — see evaporation, condensation, precipitation, runoff and groundwater in action.

title: Solar System to Scale
summary: Compare the true sizes and distances of the planets, watch them orbit with Kepler’s third law, time sunlight’s journey and build a scale model in your head.

title: CPR Rhythm Trainer
summary: Practise the life-saving rhythm of hands-only CPR: 100–120 compressions a minute, 5–6 cm deep, with a metronome, depth gauge, live rate graph and the 30:2 cycle.

title: Ecosystem: Predators & Prey
summary: Run a living Lotka–Volterra model of rabbits, foxes and grass: watch boom-and-bust cycles, carrying capacity, extinction and the surprising effects of droughts.

title: Balance the Equation
summary: Balance real chemical reactions by changing coefficients and watching atoms and masses on both sides — the law of conservation of mass made visible.

title: Sound Waves Lab
summary: Hear and see sound: change frequency, amplitude and waveform, watch air molecules squeeze and stretch, measure wavelength (v = fλ), make beats and octaves.

title: Map Skills
summary: Read a topographic map of the town of Vidyapur: grid references, compass directions and bearings, measuring distance with a scale, map symbols and contour lines.

title: Touch Typing Lab
summary: Learn to type without looking: home row, finger zones, top and bottom rows and full sentences, with live words-per-minute, accuracy and a colour-coded keyboard.

title: Statistics Explorer
summary: Build data sets by tapping, then watch mean, median, mode, quartiles, standard deviation, box plots and histograms respond — plus a hands-on central limit theorem simulator.
